title: supervisor MCP timed out twice (-32001); CLI fallback used
body: supervisor__verdict and supervisor__fanout_search MCP calls returned error -32001 Request timed out at session start; per AGENTS.md fallback rule the CLI tools (session_start.py unified verdict, engram_supervise.py) were used instead and delivered CLARIFY consistently. MCP server works for plan_items/triage_plan/task_detail, so the timeout is load/latency-bound, not a dead server.

title: git at C:/Azazael root fails - repo root is C:/Azazael/azazael
body: Ran git log from C:/Azazael (the Freebuff session project root) and got fatal: not a git repository. The project root contains TWO nested repos (azazael/.git, azazael-coord/.git); every git command must cd into one of them. Discovered via ls -d */.git probe after the failure.

title: Inline python -c with nested quoting raised SyntaxError; heredoc script file works
body: An inline python -c used for the azazael-coord scan broke on backslash/path quoting and raised SyntaxError: unexpected character after line continuation character. Re-ran as a heredoc-written /tmp script invoked via cygpath -w. Same failure class as the recorded over-scripting lesson: keep analysis code in script files, not shell-quoted one-liners.

title: grep -c on unreadable files yields empty; bash [ -gt ] spews integer expression errors
body: Shell loop tested [ "$n" -gt 0 ] where n came from grep -c that output nothing for unreadable/binary files, producing ~400 'integer expression expected' stderr lines and silently skipping those files. Guard with [ -n "$n" ] or do counting in Python. The errors were noise, but the silent skip hid real candidates until a Python rescan.

title: FALSIFIED own finding: DEAD-AT-HEAD was actually alive-untracked
body: First forensic pass declared state/BRIEF_884_MIMO_MERGE.md and state/MIMO_STRAIGHTEN_REPORT dead because git cat-file -e HEAD: failed. Both exist in the worktree as UNTRACKED files (git-invisible). Corrected with a full-depth find before reporting. Git-tracked absence is not filesystem absence; checks must cover both planes.

title: Read-only audit baseline saved as a COUNT not a list - delta unattributable
body: Saved git status --porcelain | wc -l (12) before the sweep; later the count was 13 with no repo writes issued by any command (all outputs to %TEMP% and /tmp). Because only the count was instrumented, the changed entry cannot be attributed - suspected concurrent lane or daemon. Save the full entry list as the baseline in future read-only passes.

title: Env-drift probe checked root/docs/state only - absences are not proofs of absence
body: The environment drift probe searched root, docs and state in each local env (find -maxdepth 3 in WSL), so subdir copies (skills/, research/, output/) were undercounted - RESEARCH_RECORD.md and EVE_UNLEASHED_TODO.md appeared missing from windows until a full find located them. Table absences were reported with an explicit scope caveat instead of as negatives.

title: G: archive manifest grep required format check before claiming file absence
body: Before declaring 2 task files absent from the 5080-file archive, read MANIFEST.jsonl row format ({tier,src,dst,bytes,sha256,verified}) and confirmed the name-based grep covers the stored paths; broad keyword grep also returned 0. Verification rule 4 applied: read the cited line before accepting the instrument's finding.

title: Bulk gate blocked the 3961-line deletion commit; sanctioned ALLOW_BULK_COMMIT=1 used
body: Pre-commit bulk gate rejected the NEURAL_MESH_FUNCTION_TODO.md deletion (3961 lines vs 150/file cap). Analyzed before re-running: a deletion cannot be split, and the gate's own contract offers ALLOW_BULK_COMMIT=1 as a declaration to justify in the commit message. Re-ran with the flag and full in-message justification; all six gates then green (scanner, canon, ratchet, mesh, paradigm, supervisor).

title: FALSIFIED own class: checkbox-regex counts vs status-marker counts are incommensurable
body: The forensic class 'CONSUMED-BUT-OPEN (zero checkboxes vs claimed counts)' collapsed under line-level re-verification: minted counts used BLOCKED/stale/todo status-marker rows while the sweep counted only dash-bracket checkboxes. The live files still carry their rows (T-n table, 23 status rows). Reversed the class BEFORE any disposition destroyed live task state; recorded supersedes judgment against the earlier observation.

title: Pipeline rc trap reprised three times: cmd | head; echo $? reports head's status
body: artifact_freshness rc, git grep rc and earlier grep rc were all read after a pipe, so the printed rc was head's exit code, not the instrument's. rc-carrying commands must write rc before any pipe or run unpiped. This is the same class as the recorded heredoc-pipe lint motivation; caught by re-reading each command line, not by a gate.

title: #1238 'mislocation' was a search-key artifact; item was accurate as minted
body: The plan item already named desktop/EveUnleashed_Selector/docs/POSTDOC_RESEARCH_MANIFEST.md in its Where field; only the supervisor display truncated the path to the basename, which sent the forensic search to repo root. Read the item text before correcting the item - the fix belongs to the search key, not the record.

title: SOP.md canon drift root cause: canon doc absent from SYNC_DOC_PATTERNS
body: G: source-of-truth carried a stale SOP.md with a duplicate 6-box checklist because sync_all.py never synced SOP.md - it was missing from SYNC_DOC_PATTERNS. Added it, verified membership by dry-run list inspection (count alone would not have proven it). MANDATES.md has the identical gap and is filed as a plan goal.
